name: Susan Mitchell
fact: Elected administrative vice president of Associated Student Government in the election of 14 April 1992, on the ticket the Herald listed under "The winners" alongside president Joe Rains.

src.label: Herald 67:53, 16 Apr 1992, p. 1, "Rains wins big in ASG election"

name: Ashley Rose
fact: Elected secretary of Associated Student Government in the election of 14 April 1992, named in the Herald's "The winners" box. The 1992 Talisman index enters her as Rose, S. Ashley.

src.label: Herald 67:53, 16 Apr 1992, p. 1, "Rains wins big in ASG election"

name: Patrick Monahan
fact: SPELLING DOUBT, flagged not fixed. Elected public relations vice president in the election of 14 April 1992, but the Herald's own winners box spells him Patrick Monohan, and the 1992 Talisman spells him Patrick Monohan too, on p. 181 among the Spirit Masters and at Monohan, Patrick 181 in its index. The archive carries this officer as Patrick Monahan and separately carries a Pat Monohan on the 1993-94 Judicial Council. Whether that is one person under two spellings or two people is not established here.

src.label: Herald 67:53, 16 Apr 1992, p. 1, "Rains wins big in ASG election"; 1992 Talisman, p. 181

name: Andrea Wilson
fact: As an ASG congress member she co-authored, with Andrea Cailles, the bill creating an ad hoc committee to rewrite the University Student Health Insurance Committee's plan, passed at the meeting of 7 April 1992.

src.label: Herald 67:51, 9 Apr 1992, p. 6, "Bill supporting football team passes"

name: Andrea Wilson
fact: Ran for vice president in April 1994 as Scott Sivley's running mate. The Herald described her SGA record as freshman representative, sophomore representative and then secretary, and called her a Somerset junior.

src.label: Herald 69:47, 5 Apr 1994, p. 3, "SIVLEY: Candidate focuses on SGA experience"

name: Scott Sivley
fact: The Herald summarised his climb as freshman class vice president, then sophomore class president, then administrative vice president, which it called SGA's number two position.

src.label: Herald 69:47, 5 Apr 1994, p. 3, "SIVLEY: Candidate focuses on SGA experience"

name: Ryan James
fact: An economics major from Nashville and president of the Sigma Phi Epsilon chapter, he won ASG's second annual "President for a Day" raffle and spent 20 November 1991 in Thomas Meredith's office. ASG president Heather Falmlen said the raffle raised more than $200, which went to a non-traditional student's family for the holidays.

src.label: Herald 67:25, 21 Nov 1991, pp. 1 and 3, "Trading places" and "MEREDITH: Student for a day"

name: Chad Lewis
fact: A junior from Scottsburg, Indiana, majoring in accounting, he ran for SGA vice president in April 1998 against Laura Hancock, telling the Herald the job was "just another step to serve students".

src.label: Herald 73:50, 16 Apr 1998, p. 3, "Race for SGA vice presidency heats up"

name: Carlene Lodmell
fact: Sworn in as vice president at SGA's year-end banquet in April 1996, described as a Versailles sophomore. IMPORTANT FOR PHOTOGRAPHS: the Herald states she and Darlene Lodmell, the incoming secretary, are twin sisters, so a face alone cannot tell the two apart and any portrait of either needs a caption that names her individually.

name: Darlene Lodmell
